notes.title: HOTFIX PATCH NOTES 25 September
notes.content: [p]Hey Operators,[/p][p]Thanks for supporting Arena Breakout: Infinite! We want you to have a fun and enjoyable experience with the game, so we will be making some updates and adjustments to it. The specifics are detailed below.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Time:[/b][/p][p]Sep. 25, 2025 (UTC+0)[/p][p][b]How to Update:[/b][/p][p]Live Update. If you are online during the update, you must exit the game, then click Update in the game's launcher to complete the update. [/p][p][/p][p]Live Update. If you are online during the update, you must exit the game and then update the game in your Steam Library.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Updated Content:[/b][/p][p]Event Updates and Changes[/p][p][b]1. Login Rewards[/b][/p][p][b]Event Time:[/b] Sep. 30 – Oct. 07 (UTC+0)[/p][p]Check in daily to claim a wealth of rewards, including a Weapon Skin Voucher, Pet Voucher, Universal Keycard Chain, Advanced Quick Kit, and Premium Random Koen Bundle![/p][p]2. Twilight Embers Military Supply duration has been extended, with the end date adjusted to October 30, 2025.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][p]1. Added a starting limit for Lockdown Zone: 1,000,000 Koen Coins. If the value of the equipment exceeds the limit, the match cannot be initiated.  [/p][p]2. Increased the scanning range of the Recon Terminal on the TV Station map, from scanning the 1st-floor area to scanning the 1st and 2nd-floor areas.  [/p][p]3. Increased the basic stats of the MDR Integrated Handguard.[/p][p]Vertical Recoil Control: 6 -> 7[/p][p]Horizontal Recoil Control: 7 -> 11[/p][p]4. Fixed the issue with incorrect selling prices for 3 types of cards in the Night City Defender event.[/p][p]5. Fixed the display issue that occurs when returning to the Lobby from the shooting range after equipping the Banishing Blade.[/p][p]6. Fixed the display issue with the Simple Red Dot Sight when the Twilight Embers skin is applied.[/p][p]7. Fixed the issue on the Farm map where characters could get stuck in certain areas of the Stables.[/p][p]8. Fixed the issue where the Highlights feature fails to activate automatically in Covert Ops mode.[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue where the scanning sound effects from the Recon Terminal would persist after returning to the Lobby if a player extracted while the scanning screen remained active.[/p][p]10. Fixed the issue where the Show Outfit button on the equipment screen would reset to a deactivated state after logging back into the game.[/p][p]11. Fixed the issue where the quality of items in the Trophy Room's Badge Shelf was not displayed and adjusted the arrangement order  .[/p][p]12. Fixed the issue that prompted players to purchase owned weapons when selecting a preset build.[/p][p]13. Fixed the blurry text in tactical files.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your valuable feedback and suggestions![/p][p]Happy gaming![/p][p][b]The Arena Breakout: Infinite Team[/b][/p][p][b]Sep. 24, 2025 (UTC+0)[/b][/p]

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know About Arena Breakout: Infinite
notes.content: [h3][b]Where It All Began – the Closed Beta Breakout[/b][/h3][p]In May 2024, our closed test surprised the shooter looter community. No crosshair, real gear loss on death, tangible risk: that was the first public glimpse of Arena Breakout: Infinite. After more than a year of polish, we can finally announce that Arena Breakout: Infinite arrives on Steam on 15 September. If you have not tried it yet, give us the next few minutes to win you over.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/c3c49cbee9a9176525498757d1c479c2a720e842.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]The Road to Full Release[/b][/h3][p]We kept listening to our community. One year later, the Steam Full Release lands with no more Koen purchasing option, red-tier ammo removed from market, and the strongest helmets and vests now craft-only. Our anti-cheat system has been updated 4,516 times, resulting in an 81.7% reduction in detected cheaters. HD visuals, smoother controls, larger maps, dynamic weather, and numerous other optimizations make Arena Breakout: Infinite the best it has ever been.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/3131f56331141cea2e1dac558b5bb9039bc55c83.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Than Just Another Shooter[/b][/h3][p]Unlike most shooters, Arena Breakout: Infinite isn't focused on kill counts or battle-royale rankings. You enter a sealed zone with your own gear, search for loot, collect trophies, and extract alive. Winning a fight doesn't guarantee success; only extraction does. Every enemy you encounter is another player risking all their belongings just like you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/009ad3f0da1f85f7282f11c1df906d9dc752e5b7.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Pay-to-Win? Not Any More[/b][/h3][p]As our game continues to evolve, we are refining both its economy and balance. Resource acquisition now relies entirely on gameplay and effort: the gold-purchasing system has been fully closed. Likewise, red-tier ammo and the best armor & helmet will only be obtained through crafting or battlefield encounters, no longer through market trade. Arena Breakout: Infinite aims to ensure that every achievement reflects real strategy and dedication, bringing gear and wealth back to the true challenge and enjoyment of the game. This is a world where victory is defined by judgment and courage, not by shortcuts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/a0da52522b96c87c292c3536df5aa223c113c334.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Realism with Purpose[/b][/h3][p]Players love Arena Breakout: Infinite for the subtle systems that reveal themselves over time.[/p][p]Rain drowns out footsteps. After losing a skirmish, dive into the downpour and slip away while pursuers hear nothing but rain.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/e02a5218d93d018a131b2a3bb2a13e9fc55621b2.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fog wipes the far horizon. A squad caught in a tightening noose can use the haze to pivot, flank, and escape what looked like a sure wipe.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/a6da0debcd015c143d6e115bf9b2ac1bd6da12bf.gif"][/img][/p][p]Sunlight betrays the careless. At certain hours, a low sun stretches your shadow around corners, casting a shadow on anyone watching the wall.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/cee0053b66c213fe2e4ee38749e3f3b0a3d66496.gif"][/img][/p][p]Sound is pure intel. You can tell if an enemy upstairs is reloading or popping painkillers in the kitchen.[/p][p]Gears such as Life sensors, grenades, and masks are built for results, not flash. Plan ahead, fire only when it matters, and walk out rich.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Five Distinct Maps[/b][/h3][p]If you're new to the Dark Zone, Farm is the ideal place to start.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/3f6caccfe4aee3892c7ae399928a5214f0db31bb.gif"][/img][/p][p]It has decent loot, a tight layout, and short extraction routes, making it perfect for learning through action. Many knife runners also return here for quick comeback chances. With new areas added in Season 2, this beginner-friendly map now offers more room for tactical plays.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/429138ee32161531a25d01307f7e7c7e455c6aee.gif"][/img][/p][p]TV Station is a very different experience.[/p][p]Designed for players who enjoy intense close-quarters combat, this small indoor map is packed with staircases, corners, and tight spaces. It has the highest fight frequency and is best suited for those who love fast, high-pressure gunfights.Besides these two popular maps, there are three more with distinct styles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/585453f021c2b3cca3982128601f921853c9360e.gif"][/img][/p][p]Armory features enclosed combat zones with dense loot, better for coordinated squads.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/f850f881fc982c2c4751ca7185d6c546a2856f61.gif"][/img][/p][p]Valley and Northridge offer long sightlines, high ground, and forested cover. Perfect for ambushes, sniping, or staying off the radar.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2c1af39b613f5774fb2aa1b8407e4e136f8e4f94.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Start Safe, Then Risk Big[/b][/h3][p]Visit the Shooting Range first. Test every weapon and explore the Gunsmith. Build from the bolt carrier up; barrels affect damage and effective range, ergonomics affect stamina cost while aiming, and recoil is only the beginning. When you have a favourite setup, try Secure Ops first. In this mode, a failed run does not cost gear loss, making it perfect for learning routes, loot spots, and hiding places. Soon you will realise that timing, audio cues, and custom weapons matter more than raw aim.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/0930469fcdfd5b40bb36c9ccbbc253f0f5e3f8cf.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Choose Your Approach[/b][/h3][p]Inside a raid, you choose how to roll.[/p][p]Some operators go lone wolf, grab loot with a shotgun, and sprint for the exit. Others run tight four-person teams, sweeping every corner for targets and treasure.[/p][p]Standard in-game voice keeps your fireteam synced, and next season's new Squad Channel will let smaller groups talk freely without the rest of the team hearing.[/p][p]Whether you're a Rookie or Vet, you are welcome to hop into our Discord "Vets Help Rookies" program next season. Packed supply drops and guidance will help everyone hit the ground running.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/e2f8742a8b3541670157628fd932d75a1c3d4ff0.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Than Just Combat[/b][/h3][p]Between raids, you manage your Trophy Room, craft equipment, boost fitness, and display collectibles. After every run, you sort loot, repair armor, and repack magazines. To make money, you can run low-risk materials loot and sell them for high. To chase high-end gear, you invest resources and accept risks. The more you understand, the deeper the loop pulls you in.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/0fc7d86a46708cdd30c69e27d896bd8d88a3df14.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Why Play Now[/b][/h3][p]ABI has steadily grown into the game it is today, shaped by richer content and constant community-driven improvements. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/0e877c81911e08138df1d41385f08cb6ecdc911c.png"][/img][/p][p]Its evolution is built not on marketing spend, but on consistent updates and feedback that make each battle more engaging and rewarding. If you want a shooter where survival depends on skill, quick reads, and solid prep, this build is the one to try. Casual operators can still profit by smart routing and keen ears, steering clear of gunfights and scooping up valuables; treasures in Kamona are scattered far beyond the obvious hotspots. The game is free to download, sells no stat boosts, and lets you set your own pace—charge in or play it safe as you please. Starting with the Steam Full Release, every operator can unlock the largest 3 × 3 Secure Case for free by completing seasonal tasks, giving you extra space to haul your winnings home.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all for today, and don't forgot to follow our official channels for first-hand updates, dev insights, and community events. See you soon in Kamona.[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Arena Breakout: Infinite coming to Steam on Sept. 15!
notes.content: [h3]Today marks a special moment for Arena Breakout: Infinite.[/h3][h3]We will officially arrive on Steam on[b] September 15![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Since the first PC Closed Beta in May 2024, it has been nearly 500 days of continuous development, with S0 laying the foundation, S1 introducing TV Station, Northridge and Solo Ops, and S2 expanding existing maps while making Solo Ops permanent. [/p][p][/p][p]Over 2.1 million wishlists, more than one million community members, tens of millions of feedback signals, and four major updates. All of it has led to this moment. What comes next is the answer we built together — the Full Release.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/593f859929339ccf6e338ef59ce100bf7f36d689.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Core Commitments[/b][/h2][p]We know there are questions — about fairness, about balance, about the heart of a true immersive tactical extraction shooter. Let us be clear:[/p][h3][b]Fair Play[/b][/h3][p]Koens are no longer sold in the store.[/p][p]Top-tier ammo and armor have been removed from the market.[/p][p]Weekly Violation Reports reveal ban and compensation data.[/p][p]The ACE dual-engine anti-cheat system and behavior-based monitoring work around the clock to ensure every battle is shaped by strategy and skill.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Immersive Realism[/b][/h3][p]Operators need to eat and stay hydrated.[/p][p]Broken bones slow you down.[/p][p]Dynamic weather affects your tactical decisions.[/p][p]There are no superhuman bodies and no magical powers.[/p][p]Only your heartbeat and your judgment determine your survival.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Community Co-Creation[/b][/h3][p]We actively listen to community voices.[/p][p]Through Dev talks and blogs, AMAs, and continuous feedback collection, we're strengthening our connection with the community.[/p][p]Our goal is to build a better game together.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/8027ddb74cdf757636709bb42c61af4c8803f52d.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Steam Launch Bonus[/b][/h2][p]To celebrate the Steam launch, we've prepared a welcome gift pack for all Operators:[/p][h3][b]● Enhanced Season Rewards:[/b][/h3][p]Starting in this season, you can earn [b]60 days of Basic elite privilege[/b] by completing seasonal missions.[/p][p]Complete seasonal missions and receive a [b]FREE 3x3 Secure Case[/b] with full-season availability.[/p][p]This is our way of thanking players who have supported ABI.[/p][h3][b]● Weapon Skins:[/b][/h3][p]Unlock [b]over 9 free gun skins[/b] by participating in full release events, and more free skins are on the way as thanks for your continued support.[/p][h3]● [b]And More:[/b][/h3][p]Namecards, badges, charms, and over [b]30 days of Basic Elite cards[/b]. All free, all waiting for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/e1a4898d7a9fea0ecacf2cf00a3030c7327da737.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Take Action Now[/b][/h2][h3][b]Add the Game to Your Wishlist[/b][/h3][p]Secure your spot. Downloads will open on September 15th.[/p][h3][b]Join the Official Socials[/b][/h3][p]Find teammates or mentors and plan your extraction route for Day One.[/p][p] [/p][p]Our arrival on Steam marks a new chapter.[/p][p]The journey continues, with more updates and surprises ahead.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you to every Closed Beta pioneer, every bug hunter, and every veteran who waited patiently.[/p][p][b]Let your extractions become your badge of honor![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Arena Breakout: Infinite Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/871cb5d9d61409f43eac269326ea3ab1efbc3ef4.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]FAQ[/b][/h2][p][b]Q: [/b]How can I link my game account to Steam?[/p][p][b]A: [/b]After launching the game, log in with the same Level Infinite Pass you previously used for the launcher.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: [/b]Will my previous playtime and achievements sync on Steam?[/p][p][b]A:[/b] No, Steam achievements are currently not supported.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: [/b]Is cross-progression available across platforms?[/p][p][b]A: [/b]Yes, players will be available to play across Steam, Epic, and Official website build, as long as you log in with the same Level Infinite Pass account, all your game data will stay in sync.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q:[/b] Do I need to download Steam version while I already have Official website build?[/p][p][b]A:[/b] Yes, you will need to download the Steam version if you want to play on Steam platform.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: [/b]Does the game support Linux or Steam Deck?[/p][p][b]A:[/b] No, not at this time.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Q: [/b]Does the game support controllers?[/p][p][b]A:[/b] Not supported for now[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Q: [/b]How can I provide feedback or report issues?[/p][p][b]A: [/b]We take community feedback seriously. You can contact our support team through the following ways:[/p][p]● In-game: Go to Settings - Privacy - Customer Service to submit feedback.[/p][p]● Official Website: Visit [url="https://www.arenabreakoutinfinite.com"]https://www.arenabreakoutinfinite.com[/url] - Support - Contact Us to reach customer service.[/p][p]● You may also join our game communities to leave suggestions or get help.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2bd7cdb023687a2c7ff0c01761e719a53adf9474.png"][/img] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073620"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: From Beta to Future, Arena Breakout: Infinite Community Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The round of test for "Arena Breakout: Infinite" has now concluded, and the servers have officially shut down. As this was an exclusive beta trial, all associated game data is scheduled for deletion within the coming 30 business days. 

Ever since we released the first official announcement on STEAM, our game has garnered over 1 million on our Wishlist. We're very thankful to our vibrant community for your constant support and the suggestions that have helped us fine-tune and elevate our game. Your enthusiasm and input are the driving forces behind our continuous improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2b31b72ea1710b5553af360a4b843cb3d063c781.jpg[/img]

Seizing this moment, we would like to share our upcoming plans and address the concerns that are frequently on the minds of our players. 

[b]Q1: Further Update Plans and Launch Milestones [/b]

We've been thrilled by the enthusiastic response and the flood of questions from our players. Your energy and support are greatly appreciated. Our team is fully dedicated to refining the game based on feedback from our test and is actively expanding the game with fresh experiences, including the introduction of new weapons, new maps, and continuous improvement of the QOL systems.
We're working hard to ensure that these updates are released for your enjoyment at the earliest opportunity. For further information, please visit our official social channels and stay connected for updates you won't want to miss!

[b]Q2: About Game Fairness and Subsequent Anti-Cheat Measures[/b]

ABI maintains a strict stance against any breaches of in-game rules and activities that compromise the game's integrity. To date, we have established a robust anti-cheat framework encompassing these four key strategies:

1.	Enhanced endpoint protection: Encrypted user-end code/data to increase the level of protection against hacking, debugging, and tampering.
2.	Cheating tool sample detection: ACE collects cheating tool samples, tests and analyzes them, identifies their characteristics, and enforces block penalties.
3.	Replay automated analysis and manual review: ACE analyzes replay data, restores in-game scenes and operation, uses deep learning models for intelligent analysis, identifies suspicious cheating users for manual review, detects cheating users, and enforces bans.
4.	DMA unauthorized equipment specialized testing: ACE collects DMA-related device information, tests and analyzes device characteristics, builds an unauthorized device library, evaluates user gaming behavior and replay data, identifies cheating users, and applies block penalties.

In the upcoming versions, we will continue to refine our plans and add new features to enhance the experience and improve the gaming environment:

1.	New feature: Kill-Cam.
2.	ACE's memory encryption solution will protect game memory data from DMA cheating tools.
3.	Machine blocking function for blocking malicious users' equipment.

[b]Q3: About Monetization Systems[/b]

There has been quite a bit of discussion among the community about whether "ABI's business model will be Pay-to-Win (P2W)".
ABI operates on a Free-to-Play (F2P) model, aiming to keep the doors wide open for all players. Our in-game purchases focus on offering convenience and personalized customization, steering clear of a Pay-to-Win approach. Whether you pay for it or not, being part of our player base is a big nod of approval to us, and we're truly grateful for it.


In ABI, the balance of combat, the sharpness of your wits, and the importance of your operations truly matter, and these cannot be bought or influenced by payment. Koens, Weapon, Gear, Medical supplies, and other combat essentials are not restricted to those who pay—you can obtain them by trading, looting, taking down enemies, and completing missions.

ABI represents the first PC product from Morefun Studios in many years, after over three years in development. We are expecting great things with this game and are fully committed to it—listening to your feedback, considering every detail, implementing changes, and growing with each step. Your voice matters to us, and we are eternally grateful to all who have joined us in playing our game and being part of our community.

See you in the Dark Zone soon,
Arena Breakout: Infinite Team

notes.title: Join the Closed Beta Creator Incentive Program
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the closed beta creator Incentive Program. Come and showcase your skills and earn enticing rewards while streaming Arena Breakout: Infinite!


[b]Date: [/b]May 9th to May 15th 


[b]Cash rewards:[/b]
–The top five by Peak Concurrent Viewers will each receive $1000


[b]In-game item rewards:[/b]
- Submit one stream session with more than 500 video views, you will win 100,000 Beta server Koen as a token of appreciation. 
–Total prize pool of 50,000,000 Koen. It’s first-come, first-served.


[b]Eligibility and Guidelines:[/b]
- Closed beta players and creators are eligible.
- Twitch streams are recommended with Twitch Drops enabled. Viewers have a chance to win steam keys to join the beta from drops.
- Streams must be of the PC version- ArenaBreakout: Infinite, with correct tags applied.
- Genuine gameplay is encouraged; no AFK farming.
- Recommended hashtags: #ArenaBreakoutPC #ABI #ArenaBreakoutInfinite.


[b]How to Participate:[/b]
- Stream on Arena Breakout: Infinite Twitch or YouTube.
- Submit your works to https://t.ly/ABIStreamer
- You can submit multiple livestream links. The best performance stream will be used as your award criteria. You can get cash rewards and Koen rewards at the same time. However, each person can only receive cash and Koen rewards once.


[b]Reward distribution:[/b]
-The list of in-game item winners will be announced in Discord on May 17th
-The in-game items will be distributed to winners’ in-game storage within May 17th
-Our team will verify the identity and data authenticity of the winners after the event and start the activity. The list of winners of cash prizes will be announced on May 22nd and will be distributed via bank transfer or paypal within three weeks after the event.
-For regions or users who have difficulty receiving cash, rewards will be replaced with gift cards, etc., but some losses may occur.


Join us in the ultimate gaming extravaganza, and let's break some records together!
